links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT answers across repeated runs of the same questions
links.effect: Reproducibility was 98% across the childhood cancer questions.

links.outcome: Expert-graded empathy, communication and emotional support in ChatGPT responses
links.effect: B grade for empathy and A for effective communication on ten questions; emotional support scored B eight times and C twice.
links.quote: When evaluated on ten questions about humanistic care and emotional support for children with cancer, ChatGPT received a "B" grade in empathy and an "A" in effective communication.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline accuracy and emotional support capabilities on childhood cancer questions using expert scoring, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
